INSERT INTO iam_requests (
                request_id, deployment_id, realm, operation, actor, phase, created_at, expires_at
            )
            SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'pending', $6, $7
            WHERE (
                SELECT count(*)
                FROM iam_requests
                WHERE deployment_id = $2
                  AND phase <> 'delivered'
                  AND expires_at > $6
            ) < $8
